name: Pod avtorstvom Ljusi
source: The girl wakes up in a house enveloped in a strange white mist. And all around: books, paintings, objects seem to her so familiar, but at the same time unreal, and unusual inhabitants of the house are clearly against her presence here. In the records that she finds, there can be both a beautiful story in verse and a tragic appeal for help. However, the girl is sure that there should see something else, for this reason she whant to understand why the mysterious stranger left them here. But will he solve this story or will he try to destroy everything?
translation: 女孩在一间被奇怪的白雾笼罩的房子里醒来。周围的一切：书籍、绘画、物品对她来说都是那么熟悉，但同时又不真实，而且房子里不寻常的居民显然反对她在这里的存在。在她发现的记录中，既有美丽的诗句故事，也有悲惨的求救声。不过，女孩确信那里应该看到别的东西，因此她想了解神秘的陌生人为何将他们留在这里。但他会解决这个故事还是会试图摧毁一切？
